meta.evidence_class: certificate (floating point, every age bound) + simulation (constant and random schedules per age)

study: age sweep: certificate of the fixed FB design (certify_fb, lam 0.065, V^hnd 1e-2, lags 41, 41; reference and gain fixed at the design) at every age bound; constant transport age - T_m (held age exactly the age bound) and 20 random schedules per age with d_j in 1..age/T_m - 1 (seed 700 + age); FB digital law (zoh, T_u = 1 ms) at h = 0.001 s; horizon T_xi + 8 s + 2 (n-1) dbar; observations against the certificate at that age (when its recursion closes; certified only where admitted) and against the design certificate at 20 ms; requirements: dispersion <= 1.0 s, marker error <= 3 m, terminal gap error <= 1 m, no filter modification or saturation, no contact, all stopped
